subject: Kickoff: federated vision benchmark suite
body:
Team — kicking off the federated vision benchmark track for trust-theory.

Our open-source splits give us realistic non-IID client distributions — Landmarks-User-160k with 1,262 users over 2,028 classes, and the iNaturalist splits with both per-user and geographic partitions — which is exactly what our federated-learning claims need to be evaluated against, instead of synthetic CIFAR shards.

Goal: a Meridian-internal federated eval suite on Evalline with these splits as the default benchmark, plus ingestion of partner-contributed imagery into the same user-partitioned format.

Milestones: splits ingested and TFF-compatible by May 8; Evalline harness integration by Jun 5; partner-data pipeline (with de-dup and QA) by early July; readout Jul 17.

Bilal and Emeka own ingestion, Gustavo the TFF harness, Halima analysis. Alina follows up on resourcing.

Ximena
